title: USB Dewpoint failed identification retains its transport
summary: - Location: indigo_drivers/aux_usbdp/indigo_aux_usbdp.driver:103-149, especially 105-106 and 146-149. - Severity: medium; confidence: high; category: functional/resource lifecycle. Owner: coordinator; status: open; nonblocking audit follow-up. - Evidence: after serial open succeeds, cleanup at line 146 is inside the successful usbdp_command(UDP_IDENTIFY_CMD) branch. Failed writes/reads return false at 149 with PRIVATE_DATA->handle still live. Targeted inspection of generated aux_connection_handler at indigo_aux_usbdp.c:447-478 confirms the open-false branch publishes ALERT/disconnected without invoking close; the next connect overwrites the stored handle. - Impact: failed identification and reconnect can leak serial handles/resources and interfere with a subsequent connection. No runtime failure was induced. - Minimal remediation: make all unsuccessful open paths close the acquired handle before returning false; retain normal connected shutdown ownership. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-1). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
